articles.title_en: The Employment Effects of a Guaranteed Income: Experimental Evidence from Two U.S. States*
articles.title_cn: 保障收入的就业效应：来自美国两个州的实验证据*
articles.abstract_en: We study the causal effects of income on a rich array of employment outcomes, leveraging an experiment in which 1,000 low-income individuals were randomized into receiving $1,000 per month unconditionally for three years, with a control group of 2,000 participants receiving $50/month. We gather detailed survey data, administrative records, and data from a mobile phone app. The transfer caused total individual income excluding the transfers to fall by about $1,900/year relative to the control group and a 4.2 percentage point decrease in labor market participation. Participants reduced their work hours as a result of the transfers by 1–2 hours/week and participants’ partners reduced their work hours by a comparable amount. Among other categories of time use, the greatest increase generated by the transfer was in time spent on leisure. Despite asking detailed questions about amenities, we find no effect on quality of employment, and our confidence intervals can rule out even small improvements. Treated participants broadly increase expenditures, led by spending on nondurable goods and services, with smaller increases in spending on durable goods and human capital. We observe no significant effects on degree attainment, though the magnitudes of the estimated effects generally appear larger among younger participants. Measures of subjective well-being are higher among treated participants in the first year of the transfers but then revert to control-group levels. Overall, our results suggest a moderate labor supply effect that does not appear offset by other productive activities.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究收入对多项就业结果的因果影响。实验将1,000名低收入者随机分配至无条件每月领取1,000美元、持续三年的处理组，并设置2,000名每月领取50美元的对照组。我们收集详细问卷、行政记录及手机应用数据。与对照组相比，转移支付使个人剔除转移支付后的全年总收入减少约1,900美元，劳动参与率下降4.2个百分点。受试者每周工作时间减少1至2小时，其伴侣的工作时间也出现相近幅度的下降。在其他时间用途方面，转移支付带来的最大增幅发生在休闲时间。尽管我们详细询问工作条件与福利，仍未发现就业质量有变化，置信区间甚至能够排除幅度很小的改善。处理组总体支出增加，主要来自非耐用品和服务支出，耐用品与人力资本支出增幅较小。我们未发现取得学位有显著变化，但估计效应对年轻参与者通常较大。处理组主观幸福感在领取转移支付的第一年高于对照组，之后又回到对照组水平。总体上，结果表明保障收入对劳动供给有温和的负向影响，且未被其他生产性活动抵消。

articles.title_en: Retrieval Failures and Consumption Smoothing: A Field Experiment on Seasonal Poverty*
articles.title_cn: 提取失败与消费平滑：关于季节性贫困的实地实验*
articles.abstract_en: People may fail to recall and use information they already know when making decisions. We empirically investigate whether such “retrieval failures” distort consumption-smoothing behavior among Zambian farmers, who derive their income from one annual harvest and spend it over the course of the year. We document that individuals underestimate upcoming spending by 50%, creating scope for undersaving. To improve recall, we randomize an intervention that prompts people to think through their future expenses associatively in categories—without providing any external information or guidance. Treated individuals increase “remembered” expenses by 36%–60%; as predicted by the memory literature, effects are concentrated among small, irregular, and stochastic items. Immediate spending drops and, six weeks after the intervention, treated households hold 15% higher savings. They subsequently enter the hungry season—the final months of the year when consumption typically declines sharply—with one additional month of savings, leading to a flatter spending profile over the year. Households use the increased savings to self-finance additional farm investment, resulting in a 9% increase in the next year’s crop revenue. We replicate the intervention’s effect on beliefs among low-income Americans, suggesting that retrieval failures generalize across settings and populations.
articles.abstract_cn: 人们在做出决策时可能无法回忆和利用他们已知的信息。我们实证研究了这种“提取失败”是否扭曲了赞比亚农民的消费平滑行为，他们的收入来自一年一次的收获，并在一年中逐步支出。我们记录到，个体低估了即将到来的支出50%，从而为储蓄不足创造了空间。为了改善回忆，我们随机化了一项干预，促使人们以分类联想的方式思考未来的支出——而不提供任何外部信息或指导。受处理个体将“记得的”支出增加了36%–60%；正如记忆文献所预测的，效应集中在小的、不规则的和随机性的项目上。即时支出下降，并且在干预六周后，受处理家庭持有15%更高的储蓄。他们随后进入饥饿季节——一年中消费通常急剧下降的最后几个月——时多了一个月的储蓄，导致全年支出曲线更加平坦。家庭利用增加的储蓄来自我融资额外的农场投资，导致下一年的作物收入增加了9%。我们在低收入美国人中复制了干预对信念的影响，表明提取失败在不同环境和人群中具有普遍性。

articles.title_en: Beliefs About the Economy Are Excessively Sensitive to Household-Level Shocks: Evidence from Linked Survey and Administrative Data*
articles.title_cn: 关于经济的信念对家庭层面冲击过度敏感：来自关联调查与行政数据的证据*
articles.abstract_en: We study how people’s beliefs about the economy covary with household-level events, using a unique link between Danish administrative data and a large-scale survey of consumer expectations. We find that compared to actual inflation, people’s inflation forecasts covary much more strongly (and negatively) with both recently realized household income changes and measures of expected future household income changes. We formally establish that these findings are stark deviations from the Bayesian rational expectations benchmark. Similar results hold for perceptions of past inflation (backcasts), suggesting that imperfect recall is a key mechanism for biased forecasts. Building on this, a series of additional tests, some of which use data on adverse health events, suggests that the forecast biases are at least partly due to affect-cued recall. That is, negative (positive) household-level events cue negative (positive) recollections, which lead to pessimistic (optimistic) forecasts.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们利用丹麦行政数据与一项大规模消费者预期调查之间的独特关联，研究人们对经济的信念如何与家庭层面事件共同变动。我们发现，与实际通胀相比，人们的通胀预测与近期已实现的家庭收入变化以及预期未来家庭收入变化的度量都表现出强得多（且为负向）的共同变动。我们正式确立，这些发现与贝叶斯理性预期基准存在显著偏离。类似结果也适用于对过去通胀的感知（回溯预测），表明不完美回忆是偏误预测的一个关键机制。在此基础上，一系列额外检验——其中一些使用了不良健康事件的数据——表明预测偏误至少部分源于情感线索回忆。也就是说，负面（正面）家庭层面事件会引出负面（正面）回忆，进而导致悲观（乐观）预测。

articles.title_en: What Jobs Come to Mind? Stereotypes About Fields of Study*
articles.title_cn: 哪些工作会浮现在脑海中？关于研究领域的刻板印象*
articles.abstract_en: We test for stereotyping—the exaggeration of representative traits—in a high-stakes economic environment. Using surveys administered among undergraduates at the Ohio State University as well as large-scale nationally representative data, we measure how U.S. first-year students perceive the relationship between college majors and occupations. We show that students greatly overestimate the likelihood that majors lead to their representative jobs (e.g., counselor for psychology, journalist for journalism). Using an implicit association test, we show that students associate majors with their representative careers and that these associations strongly predict belief biases, in line with a stereotyping mechanism. A simple equilibrium model of the labor market predicts that stereotyping reduces welfare by increasing misallocation, which we corroborate with correlational evidence on job/major mismatch. In a field experiment, we test a light-touch policy to reduce stereotyping and find significant effects on students’ intentions about what to study as well as the classes and majors they enroll in.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们在一个高利害的经济环境中检验刻板印象——即对代表性特征的夸大。利用在俄亥俄州立大学本科生中进行的调查以及大规模全国代表性数据，我们测量了美国一年级学生如何感知大学专业与职业之间的关系。我们表明，学生极大地高估了专业通向其代表性工作的可能性（例如，心理学专业通向咨询师，新闻学专业通向记者）。使用内隐联想测验，我们表明学生将专业与其代表性职业联系起来，并且这些联系强烈预测信念偏差，这与刻板印象机制一致。一个简单的劳动力市场均衡模型预测，刻板印象通过增加错配而降低福利，我们用关于工作/专业错配的相关性证据证实了这一点。在一项实地实验中，我们测试了一项轻触式政策以减少刻板印象，并发现对学生关于学习什么的意图以及他们注册的课程和专业有显著影响。

articles.title_en: Mental Models of the Stock Market*
articles.abstract_en: Investors’ return expectations are pivotal in stock markets, but the reasoning behind these expectations is not well understood. This article explores economic agents’ mental models of what drives returns. We survey the general population, retail investors, financial professionals, and academic experts to investigate how they forecast and explain future returns in scenarios with stale news about future company earnings. We find that investors strongly disagree in their forecasts and reasoning. Most academic experts view markets as efficient. By contrast, most households express a perspective we call “expected earnings reasoning”: they directly equate higher expected earnings with higher expected returns. Professionals are split between market efficiency, mispricing, and expected earnings reasoning. In detailed experiments, we dissect why households adopt expected earnings reasoning. We show that it arises from inattention to how stock price changes affect investor costs—that is, how much investors must pay to acquire a claim to future cash flows—because the typical format and context of investment problems obscure these cost implications. Our results help connect a series of previously documented anomalies in expectation and trading data and highlight the importance of selective attention and context in shaping reasoning and belief formation.
articles.abstract_cn: 投资者的回报预期在股票市场中至关重要，但这些预期背后的推理过程尚未被充分理解。本文探讨了经济主体关于回报驱动因素的心理模型。我们调查了一般人群、散户投资者、金融专业人士和学术专家，以研究他们在存在关于未来公司盈利的过时新闻的情景下如何预测和解释未来回报。我们发现，投资者在预测和推理上存在强烈分歧。大多数学术专家将市场视为有效。相比之下，大多数家庭表达了一种我们称之为“预期盈利推理”的观点：他们直接将更高的预期盈利等同于更高的预期回报。专业人士则在市场有效性、错误定价和预期盈利推理之间分化。在详细实验中，我们剖析了家庭为何采用预期盈利推理。我们表明，它源于对股价变化如何影响投资者成本的忽视——即投资者必须支付多少才能获得对未来现金流的索取权——因为投资问题的典型格式和背景掩盖了这些成本含义。我们的结果有助于将一系列先前记录的预期和交易数据中的异象联系起来，并凸显了选择性注意和背景在塑造推理和信念形成中的重要性。

articles.abstract_en: This article provides the first comprehensive global evidence on people’s fairness and efficiency preferences, beliefs about the sources of inequality and the efficiency cost of redistribution, and policy attitudes toward redistribution. Using a globally harmonized consequential experiment with more than 65,000 individuals across 60 countries, we show that the source of inequality plays a substantially larger role for inequality acceptance than the efficiency cost of redistribution. At the global level, implemented inequality increases by 85% when inequality is caused by merit rather than luck, compared with a 14% increase when redistribution entails a 50% efficiency cost. We document substantial heterogeneity in fairness views and beliefs within and across societies. The meritocratic fairness view is most prominent in many richer Western societies, while libertarian and egalitarian fairness views are widespread in many other parts of the world. Globally, people are more likely to believe that inequality reflects luck rather than merit, while beliefs in large efficiency costs of redistribution are relatively weak. Fairness preferences and beliefs are strongly associated with redistribution attitudes and actual redistribution through taxes and transfers across countries. Our findings illustrate how the interaction between fairness views and beliefs may shape redistribution across societies, highlighting the importance of jointly understanding preferences and beliefs in the political economy of redistribution.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文首次提供了关于人们的公平与效率偏好、对不平等来源和再分配效率成本的信念，以及对再分配的政策态度的全面全球证据。我们使用一项在全球范围内协调实施的有后果实验，涵盖60个国家的超过65,000名个体，表明不平等来源对不平等接受度的作用远大于再分配的效率成本。在全球层面，当不平等由功绩而非运气造成时，实际实施的不平等增加85%，相比之下，当再分配带来50%的效率成本时，不平等增加14%。我们记录了各社会内部和之间在公平观和信念上的显著异质性。精英主义公平观在许多较富裕的西方社会最为突出，而自由至上主义和平均主义公平观在世界许多其他地区广泛存在。在全球范围内，人们更倾向于认为不平等反映的是运气而非功绩，而认为再分配具有巨大效率成本的信念相对较弱。公平偏好和信念与各国的再分配态度以及通过税收和转移支付实现的实际再分配密切相关。我们的发现说明了公平观与信念之间的相互作用如何塑造各社会的再分配，凸显了在再分配政治经济学中共同理解偏好与信念的重要性。

articles.title_en: Bringing Work Home: Flexible Work Arrangements as Gateway Jobs for Women in West Bengal*
articles.title_cn: 把工作带回家：灵活工作安排作为西孟加拉邦妇女的门户工作*
articles.abstract_en: There is a large latent workforce in developing countries that consists of hundreds of millions of women who prefer to have paid work and yet are out of the labor force. Often, available job opportunities are incompatible with traditional gender roles that encourage women to stay at home. In a randomized experiment with 1,670 households, we partner with a jobs platform to offer short-term data work to women who are out of the labor force. We find three main results. First, flexible work-from-home jobs are highly effective at bringing women into paid work. Job flexibility more than triples take-up from 15% for an office job to 48% for a job that women can do from home while multitasking with childcare. Second, these jobs can act as a stepping stone to less flexible work. Trying paid work from home increases take-up of less flexible jobs two to three months later among women without previous work experience. “Gateway jobs” are especially important for women from more traditional households: their labor supply is more likely to be marginal to flexibility, and in turn, work experience shifts their attitudes to become less traditional. Third, from the labor demand side, remote work comes with trade-offs in worker performance. Working from the office increases accuracy by 3% and speed by 18%. However, these performance drawbacks of work-from-home arrangements may be outweighed by the increase in available workers.
articles.abstract_cn: 发展中国家存在一个庞大的潜在劳动力群体，由数亿希望从事有偿工作却仍处于劳动力队伍之外的妇女组成。现有就业机会往往与鼓励妇女留在家中的传统性别角色不相容。在一项涉及1,670户家庭的随机实验中，我们与一个就业平台合作，向处于劳动力队伍之外的妇女提供短期数据工作。我们发现三个主要结果。第一，灵活的家办公工作非常有效地将妇女带入有偿工作。工作灵活性使接受率从办公室工作的15%提高到妇女可以在家一边照看孩子一边多任务处理的工作的48%，提高了两倍以上。第二，这些工作可以成为通向灵活性较低工作的踏脚石。尝试在家从事有偿工作使没有工作经验的妇女在两到三个月后对灵活性较低工作的接受率提高。“门户工作”对来自更传统家庭的妇女尤为重要：她们的劳动供给更可能处于对灵活性的边际状态，进而，工作经验会改变她们的态度，使其变得不那么传统。第三，从劳动力需求方面看，远程工作伴随着工人绩效上的权衡。在办公室工作使准确性提高3%，速度提高18%。然而，在家办公安排在这些绩效上的不利之处可能会被可用工人数量的增加所抵消。

articles.abstract_en: If unions raise worker wages, who pays? We provide a comprehensive assessment of firm responses to increased unionization, using changes in the tax deductibility of union dues in Norway as a quasi-exogenous source of variation in firm-level union density. In the average private sector firm, higher union density raises labor costs and leads firms to contract employment and production, lowering profits without increasing the labor share. The incidence is shared: consumers bear part of the cost through higher prices, shareholders through lower profits, and the remainder is offset by productivity improvements. The total wage bill falls, with losses concentrated among less attached “outsider” workers. Firm responses vary systematically by the degree of market competition. In manufacturing, where firms operate in less competitive product and labor markets, the response is reversed: the average firm expands employment and production, reduces labor markdowns, and does not experience profit declines. Instead, higher labor costs are largely passed on to consumers through higher prices, with the remainder offset by productivity gains. Workers benefit as both wages and employment rise. These patterns suggest that unions can offset employer monopsony power and that firm responses—and therefore who ultimately bears the cost—depend importantly on market structure. Overall, unionization in this setting primarily redistributes from consumers rather than shareholders and has effects that differ sharply across firms, including a reallocation toward larger and more productive firms. We rationalize these patterns using a partial-equilibrium model of union bargaining with product- and labor-market power.
articles.abstract_cn: 如果工会提高工人工资，那么谁来买单？我们利用挪威工会会费税收可抵扣性的变化作为企业层面工会密度的准外生变异来源，全面评估了企业对工会化程度提高的应对。在平均私营部门企业中，更高的工会密度提高了劳动力成本，并导致企业收缩就业和生产，降低了利润而未提高劳动份额。成本归宿是分担的：消费者通过更高的价格承担一部分成本，股东通过更低的利润承担一部分，其余部分由生产率改进所抵消。总工资额下降，损失集中在依附性较低的“局外人”工人中。企业应对因市场竞争程度而系统性变化。在制造业中，企业运营于竞争较弱的产品和劳动力市场，其应对是相反的：平均企业扩大就业和生产，降低劳动力加价，并且没有经历利润下降。相反，更高的劳动力成本主要通过更高的价格转嫁给消费者，其余部分由生产率增益所抵消。工人受益，因为工资和就业均上升。这些模式表明，工会可以抵消雇主的买方垄断力量，并且企业应对——从而最终由谁承担成本——在很大程度上取决于市场结构。总体而言，此情境下的工会化主要从消费者而非股东进行再分配，并且其影响在不同企业间差异显著，包括向更大和更高生产率企业的再分配。我们使用一个具有产品和劳动力市场力量的工会谈判局部均衡模型来合理化这些模式。

articles.title_en: Clause and Effect: Theory and Field Experimental Evidence on Noncompete Clauses*
articles.title_cn: 条款与效应：竞业禁止条款的理论与实地实验证据*
articles.abstract_en: We study worker noncompete clauses in a large field experiment with two finance firms. Across ~14,000 job offers to freelance recruiters on short-term contracts, we randomize wages and the presence, salience, and duration of noncompetes (all contracts also included a nondisclosure agreement). Removing a noncompete increases mobility between competing employers by 36%–52% and raises workers’ total earnings from the two firms by 12%–17%. We find no evidence—rejecting even small effects—that removing noncompetes generates secret leakage. We also find no evidence that workers choose noncompete jobs for higher pay. Many workers appear unaware of noncompetes before firms’ post-employment communication. The results align with a model of inattention and uncertainty about enforcement.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们在两家金融公司开展的大型实地实验中研究工作者的竞业禁止条款。在向短期合同的自由职业招聘人员发出的约14,000份工作邀约中，我们随机化了工资以及竞业禁止条款的存在、显著性和期限（所有合同也都包含保密协议）。取消竞业禁止条款使竞争性雇主之间的人员流动增加36%–52%，并使工作者从两家公司获得的总收入提高12%–17%。我们没有发现证据——甚至拒绝小效应——表明取消竞业禁止条款会导致秘密泄露。我们也没有发现证据表明工作者为了更高薪酬而选择竞业禁止工作。许多工作者似乎在公司离职后沟通之前并未意识到竞业禁止条款。结果与一个关于注意力不集中和对执行不确定性的模型相一致。

articles.title_en: In Their Shoes: Empathy Through Information*
articles.title_cn: 设身处地：通过信息实现共情*
articles.abstract_en: We explore the mechanics of empathy. We show that information about an outgroup can activate and magnify empathy when presented in conjunction with an experience simulating their struggles. This response increases the willingness to help the struggling group. We provide evidence for this effect in an immersive virtual reality experiment where participants (witnesses) experience a simulation of the struggle of unauthorized migrants (protagonists), then replicate these results in a series of controlled lab experiments. We show that information enhances the witnesses’ empathetic response and drives them to engage in more prosocial behavior when it increases their perceived interpersonal similarity, or relatability to the protagonist—an effect we trace to attention: eye-tracking data reveal that information provision concentrates witnesses’ gaze on the struggles of the protagonist instead of searching through peripheral elements of the scene. Conversely, only information packages that strengthen perceived relatability—an effect that can vary across subgroups with heterogeneous attributes—magnify empathy. Together, our evidence suggests that the ability to put oneself in the shoes of another person or group can be enhanced by activating empathy through simple, targeted, information provision.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们探讨共情的机制。我们表明，当关于外群体的信息与模拟其困境的体验一起呈现时，这些信息能够激活并放大共情。这种反应增加了帮助困境群体的意愿。我们在一个沉浸式虚拟现实实验中为这一效应提供了证据，实验中参与者（见证者）体验了对未经授权移民（主角）困境的模拟，随后在一系列受控实验室实验中复制了这些结果。我们表明，当信息增加了见证者感知到的人际相似性，即与主角的共鸣时，信息增强了见证者的共情反应并驱使他们参与更多亲社会行为——我们将这一效应追溯到注意力：眼动追踪数据显示，信息提供将见证者的目光集中在主角的困境上，而不是在场景的边缘元素中搜寻。相反，只有强化感知共鸣的信息包——这一效应可能因具有异质性属性的子群体而异——才会放大共情。总之，我们的证据表明，设身处地为另一个人或群体着想的能力可以通过简单、有针对性的信息提供来激活共情而得到增强。

articles.title_en: Wealth and Property Taxation in the United States*
articles.abstract_en: We study the history and geography of wealth accumulation in the United States using newly collected historical property tax records from the early 1800s onward. These records come from the administration of the General Property Tax—a tax that aspired to cover all types of property. We construct wealth series at the state, county, and national levels. At the state level, we use annual assessed values of wealth from state-level reports drawn from multiple sources. Because assessed values may differ from market values, we also require assessment ratios, defined as the ratio of assessed to market wealth. We obtain state-level assessment ratios from decadal U.S. Census wealth data (drawn from various census reports, including those on “Wealth, Debt, and Taxation”), in which the census carried out detailed valuation work, complemented with information on changes in assessment practices from the state reports, to build higher-frequency series of assessment ratios. The result is long-run annual wealth series for states from 1850 (or earlier, depending on the state) to 1935. We obtain national wealth series by aggregating these state series. At the county level, we use assessed values (or market values where available) from the U.S. Census wealth data for each decade and apply either state-level or county-level assessment ratios, where available, to obtain market values of wealth for each decade from 1850 to 1930. We use these data to show, first, that the United States experienced extraordinary wealth accumulation after the Civil War and until the Great Depression. Second, spatial inequality in the United States has been large and highly persistent since the mid-1800s. We also examine the determinants of long-term wealth growth and find, among other results, that counties with a higher share of enslaved property before the Civil War or with higher wealth inequality experienced lower subsequent long-run wealth growth.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们利用新收集的自早期1800起的历史财产税记录，研究美国财富积累的历史与地理。这些记录来自一般财产税的征收管理——该税种旨在覆盖所有类型的财产。我们构建了州、县和国家层面的财富序列。在州层面，我们使用来自多个来源的州级报告中的年度财富评估值。由于评估值可能不同于市场价值，我们还需要评估比率，定义为评估财富与市场财富之比。我们从十年一次的美国人口普查财富数据（取自各种普查报告，包括“财富、债务和税收”报告）中获得州级评估比率，其中普查进行了详细的估值工作，并结合州报告中关于评估实践变化的信息，以构建更高频率的评估比率序列。结果是各州从1850（或更早，取决于州）到1935的长期年度财富序列。我们通过汇总这些州序列获得国家财富序列。在县层面，我们使用美国人口普查财富数据中每个十年的评估值（或在可获得时使用市场价值），并在可获得时应用州级或县级评估比率，以获得从1850到1930每个十年的财富市场价值。我们使用这些数据表明，第一，美国在南北战争后直至大萧条期间经历了非凡的财富积累。第二，自1800中期以来，美国的空间不平等一直很大且高度持久。我们还考察了长期财富增长的决定因素，并发现，除其他结果外，南北战争前奴隶财产份额较高或财富不平等较高的县，其随后的长期财富增长较低。

articles.title_en: Busing to Opportunity? The Impacts of the Metco Voluntary School Desegregation Program on Urban Students of Color
articles.title_cn: 通往机会的校车？METCO自愿学校种族融合项目对城市有色人种学生的影响
articles.abstract_en: School assignment policies are a key lever for expanding access to high-performing schools and promoting racial and socioeconomic integration. For over 50 years, the Metropolitan Council for Educational Opportunity (METCO) has bussed students of color from Boston, Massachusetts, to relatively wealthier and predominantly white suburbs. I estimate the effects of attending a high-performing suburban school by comparing applicants who receive enrollment offers with applicants who do not. A two-stage least squares approach exploits waitlist assignment priorities and controls for a rich set of characteristics from birth records and application data. Attending a suburban school boosts math and English test scores, reduces dropout, and increases on-time high school graduation. Four-year college aspirations, enrollment, and graduation increase along with earnings in adulthood. Students whose parents did not attend college and boys experience the largest effects. The evidence points to several mechanisms, including access to higher value-added schools, higher-achieving peers, and schools with stronger college-going norms. Participants are more likely to be tracked into lower-performing classes, implying that effects could be larger with access to more advanced coursework. District value-added estimates suggest that students’ educational trajectories shift at least as much as they would from growing up in the suburban districts.
articles.abstract_cn: 学校分配政策是扩大获得高绩效学校机会和促进种族与社会经济融合的关键杠杆。在超过50年的时间里，大都会教育机会委员会（METCO）用校车将马萨诸塞州波士顿的有色人种学生送往相对更富裕且以白人为主的郊区。我通过比较收到入学录取通知的申请人与未收到录取通知的申请人，估计了就读高绩效郊区学校的影响。两阶段最小二乘法方法利用了候补名单分配优先级，并控制了来自出生记录和申请数据的大量特征。就读郊区学校提高了数学和英语考试成绩，减少了辍学，并增加了按时高中毕业。四年制大学志向、入学和毕业以及成年后的收入均有所增加。父母未上过大学的学生和男孩受到的影响最大。证据指向若干机制，包括获得更高增值学校的机会、更高成就的同龄人以及具有更强大学升学规范的学校。参与者更有可能被分轨到表现较低的班级，这意味着如果能够获得更高级的课程，影响可能会更大。学区增值估计表明，学生的教育轨迹至少会像在郊区学区成长那样发生同等程度的变化。

articles.title_en: The Transmission of Reliable and Unreliable Information*
articles.title_cn: 可靠与不可靠信息的传播*
articles.abstract_en: Information often spreads and influences beliefs regardless of its reliability. We show that this occurs in part because indicators of reliability tend to be lost in the process of word-of-mouth transmission. We conduct controlled experiments where participants listen to economic forecasts and pass them on through voice messages. Other participants listen either to original or transmitted audio recordings and report incentivized beliefs. Across various transmitter incentive schemes, a claim’s reliability is lost in transmission much more than the claim itself. Reliable and unreliable information, once filtered through transmission, affect listeners’ beliefs similarly. Mechanism experiments show that reliability is lost not because it is perceived as less relevant or harder to transmit but because it is less likely to come to mind during transmission. Evidence from our experiments, a large corpus of everyday conversations, and economic TV news shows that contextual cues can bring reliability to mind and induce its transmission, but situations in which people share information seldom contain such cues.
articles.abstract_cn: 信息往往不论其可靠性如何都会传播并影响信念。我们表明，这部分是因为可靠性的指示在口碑传播过程中往往会丢失。我们进行受控实验，参与者收听经济预测并通过语音信息将其传递下去。其他参与者收听原始或传递后的音频录音，并报告有激励的信念。在各种传递者激励方案中，一项说法的可靠性在传递中丢失的程度远大于该说法本身。可靠和不可靠的信息，一旦经过传递过滤，对听众信念的影响相似。机制实验表明，可靠性丢失并非因为它被认为不太相关或更难传递，而是因为它不太可能在传递过程中被想到。来自我们的实验、一个大型日常对话语料库以及经济电视新闻的证据表明，情境线索可以使可靠性被想到并促使其传递，但人们分享信息的情境很少包含这样的线索。

articles.title_en: Capital Services in Global Value Chains*
articles.title_cn: 全球价值链中的资本服务*
articles.abstract_en: This article constructs the first global data set on intersectoral capital service expenditures. I use these data to disaggregate capital services and intermediate inputs in a dynamic multisector trade model. Steady-state allocations and responses to shocks are determined by a capital-augmented global input-output matrix. Two properties of the measured network deliver larger long-run consumption gains from globalization than existing estimates, as well as larger gains in more capital-intensive countries. First, more trade-exposed sectors supply capital to more consumption-influential producers. Second, heterogeneity in the network reallocates sectoral expenditures toward producers with larger declines in capital rental prices. These reallocations raise capital incomes and lower consumption price indices.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文构建了首个关于部门间资本服务支出的全球数据集。我使用这些数据在一个动态多部门贸易模型中对资本服务和中间投入进行分解。稳态配置和对冲击的响应由资本增强型全球投入产出矩阵决定。所测度网络的两种性质带来了比现有估计更大的全球化长期消费收益，以及在资本更密集国家中更大的收益。第一，更多贸易暴露的部门向更具消费影响力的生产者供应资本。第二，网络中的异质性将部门支出重新配置到资本租赁价格下降幅度更大的生产者。这些重新配置提高了资本收入并降低了消费价格指数。

articles.abstract_en: This article uses labor force surveys from 160 countries to build a new microdatabase on hours worked covering 97% of the world population in cross section. We also construct time series spanning over 20 years in 86 countries. Hours worked per adult slightly decline with GDP per capita but are weakly correlated with development overall. Hours worked by the young (aged 15–19) and elderly (aged 60+) fall with development, driven entirely by growing school attendance and public pension coverage. Hours worked among prime-age adults (aged 20–59) are stable with development but undergo a great gender reshuffling: falling hours per male worker have been exactly offset by increases in female labor force participation in many countries. Labor income taxes are strongly negatively related to hours worked across countries. This correlation is attenuated when controlling for social spending and disappears when further controlling for working hours regulations. Both social spending and working hours regulations are associated with lower hours worked.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文利用来自160个国家的劳动力调查数据，构建了一个新的工作时间微观数据库，横截面覆盖全球97%的人口。我们还构建了涵盖86个国家、时间跨度超过20年的时间序列。成年人人均工作时间随人均GDP略有下降，但总体上与发展水平相关性较弱。年轻群体（年龄15-19）和老年群体（年龄60+）的工作时间随发展而下降，这完全由不断增长的入学率和公共养老金覆盖所驱动。壮年成年人（年龄20-59）的工作时间随发展保持稳定，但经历了巨大的性别重组：在许多国家，男性工人人均工作时间的下降恰好被女性劳动参与率的上升所抵消。各国劳动所得税与工作时间呈强烈负相关。在控制社会支出后，这一相关性减弱；在进一步控制工作时间法规后，该相关性消失。社会支出和工作时间法规均与更低的工作时间相关。
